बन्ध् vt. 9P (pp. बद्ध; pres. बध्नाति; pass. बध्यते) 1. To bind, to tie, to fix, to fasten, अबद्धादपरिस्कंदं ब्रह्मपाशेन विस्फुरन् Bt.ix.75, R.vii.9, K.S.vii.25; 2. to attract, to arrest, बध्नाति मे चक्षुः … चित्रकूटः R.xiii.47, Kir.vii.17; 3. to ensnare, to catch, to take captive, to imprison, to chastise, चलिर्बबंधे Bt.ii.39, or बध्यंते निपुणैरगाधसलिलान्मत्स्याः समुद्रादपि Hit.i.; 4. to put on, to wear, Bt.xiv.7; 5. to form, to construct, to build, to compose, छायाबद्धकदंबकं मृगकुलम् Sak.ii., R.xi.35, 78, K.S.ii.47, v.30, R.xvi.5, Bt.vii.77, Megh.ii.13, 16, R.iv.38, vi.66; 6. to construct verses, to compose, e.g. श्लोक एव त्वया बद्धो नात्र कार्यां विचारणा Ram.; 7. to fix on or upon, R.iii.4, Bt.xx.22; 8. to form or bear fruit, R.xii.69.(अंजलिं बंध् ‘to place the two hands hollowed side by side.’ चित्तं, धियं or मनः बंध् ‘to set the heart on.’ प्रीतिं, भावं or रागं बंध् ‘to be enamoured of, to fall in love with.’ परिकरं बंध् ‘to gird up one’s loins.’ भ्रूकुटिं बंध् ‘to knit the eyebrows.’ मुष्टिं बंध् ‘to clench the fist.’ सेतुं बंध् ‘to construct a bridge.’ गोलं बंध् ‘to form a globe.’ सख्यं, सौहृदं or अजर्यं बंध् ‘to contract friendship.’ वैरं बंध् ‘to contract enmity.’)With अनु-, 1. to be affixed or attached to; 2. to follow, को नु खल्वयमनुबध्यमानस्तपस्विनीभ्यामबालसत्वो बालः Sak.vii.; 3. to importune, to press.With आ-, 1. to form, to compose, आबद्धरेखामभितो रविमंजरीभिः Git.G.xi., Megh.i.9, Bt.iii.30; 2. to fix on or upon, R.i.40; 3. to bind, to tie, M.xi.205.With उद्-, to tie up, to raise up and tie, K.S.iii.46, R.xvi.67.With नि-, 1. to bind, to tie, to fasten, to chain, K.S.v.10, Bg.iv.41, ix.9, xiv.7; 2. to fix, to rivet; 3. to form, to build, to construct, to compose, e.g., पाषाणचयनिबद्धे कूपे, or निबद्धं पुण्यमाख्यानं रामायणम्; 4. to compose verses.With निस्-, to press, to insist upon, to urge.With परि-, 1. to bind; 2. to put on, to encircle; 3. to stop, to interrupt.With प्रति-, 1. to tie, to bind, पीतप्रतिबद्धवत्साम् R.ii.1; 2. to set, to encase, बहलानुरागकुरुविंददलप्रतिबद्धमध्यमिव दिग्वलयम् Sis.ix.8; 3. to fix, to direct; 4. to obstruct, to keep off, to shut out, to exclude, to cut off, प्रतिबध्नाति हि श्रेयः पूज्यपूजाव्यतिक्रमः R.i.79.With सम्-, 1. to bind together, to tie together, to unite; 2. to attach, to connect; 3. to form, to construct.

बंध m. 1. Fettering, confining, imprisoning, M.v.49; 2. a bond, a tie, a fetter; 3. capturing, catching; 4. joining, uniting; 5. forming, constructing; 6. a legature, a bandage; 7. connection, intercourse; 8. agreement, union; 9. result, consequence; 10. a sinew; 11. border, framework; 12. the body; 13. manifestation, display, R.xviii.52; 14. bondage, (op. to मुक्ति in which the soul is freed from all connection with the world) (in phil.), बंधोन्मुक्त्यै खलु मल्हमुखान् कुर्वते कर्मपाशान् Bh.V.iv.21, R.xviii.7, xiii.58, Bg.xviii.30; 15. a posture, a position, K.S.iii.45, 59; 16. a form of sexual intercourse; (the Ratimanjarī mentions sixteen forms, other treatises give different numbers); 17. conceiving, fooling, R.vi.81; 18. laying snares, R.xvi.2; 19. a stanza which can be arranged in a particular shape (in rhetoric). e.g., पद्मबंध, खड्गबंध, मुरजबंध.
बंध-तंत्र n. a complete army containing chariots, elephants, horse and foot.
बंध-पारुष्य n. forced construction of words.
बंध-स्तंभ m. the post to which an elephant is tied.
बंधक (I) m. 1. A binder; 2. a catcher; 3. a ravisher; 4. a tie, a rope; 5. a bank, a dike; 6. a deposit; 7. exchange, barter; 8. a promise; 9. a city; 10. a part, a portion, ऋणं सदशबंधकम् Yaj.ii.76.
बंधक (II) n. Confinement.
बंधकी f. 1. An unchaste woman, दुर्योधनस्तु मोहादविज्ञातबंधकीहृदयसारः क्वापि परिभ्रांतः Ve.ii.; 2. a harlot, a courtezan; 3. a female elephant.

बंधन n. 1. Fastening, binding, tying, fettering, R.xii.70; 2. capturing, catching; 3. a bond, a chain, a fetter; 4. confinement, captivity, imprisonment; 5. a gaol, a prison, त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबंधास्थम् Sak.vi., M.ix.288; 6. a sinew, a muscle; 7. hurting, injuring; 8. connecting, uniting, joining; 9. forming, constructing, K.S.iv.6; 10. clasping, clutching, binding round, घटय भुजबंधनं जनय रदखंडनं येन वा भवति सुखजातम् Git.G.x.
बंधन-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -आलय न्। m.n. a gaol, a prison.
बंधन-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -आलय न्। m.n. a gaol, a prison.
बंधन-आलय n. a gaol, a prison.
बंधन-ग्रंथि m. 1. the knot of a legature; 2. a rope for tying cattle.
बंधन-पालक m. a jailer.
बंधन-वेश्मन् n. a prison, a gaol.
बंधन-स्थ m. a prisoner, a captive.
बंधन-स्तंभ m. a post to which an elephant is tied.
बंधन-स्थान n. a stall, a stable.
बंधित a. (f. ता) 1. Bound; 2. imprisoned, confined.
बंधित a. (f. ता) 1. Bound; 2. imprisoned, confined.
बंधितृ m. 1. The god of love; 2. a leathern fan.

बंधु m. 1. A relation, a kinsman in general, बंधुप्रीत्या समरविमुखो लांगली याः सिषेवे Megh.i.49, M.ii.136, R.xii.12, Bg.vi.9; 2. a term for one’s own kinsmen; (they are- sons of the father’s sister, of the mother’s sister and of the mother’s brother) (in law), See पितृबंधु and मातृबंधु; 3. a friend, बंधुप्रीत्या भवनाशिखिभिर्दत्तनृत्योपहारः Megh.i.32, ii.51; 4. a husband, वैदेहिबंधोर्हृदयं विदद्रे R.xiv.33; 5. a wife, याते च संप्रति दिवं प्रति बंधुरत्ने Bh.V.ii.1; 6. a mother; 7. a brother; 8. the bandhujīva tree; 9. (at the end of a compound) any person worthless of his class, anyone who only nominally belongs to a profession or tribe, e.g. ब्रह्मबंधु, क्षत्रबंधु.
बंधु-कृत्य n. 1. the duty of a kinsman, त्वयि तु परिसमाप्तं बंधुकृत्यं जनानाम् Sak.v.; 2. a friendly service, कच्चित् सौम्य व्यवसितमिदं बंधुकृत्यं त्वया मे Megh.ii.51.
बंधु-जन m. 1. a kinsman, relation; 2. kinsmen (collectively).
बंधु-जीव, -जीवक (I) m. name of a tree.
बंधु-जीव, -जीवक (I) m. name of a tree.
बंधु-जीवक (II) n. the flower of this tree, बंधुजीवपृथुभिः प्रदूषिताम् R.xi.25.
बंधु-ता f. 1. relations (collectively), kin, kindred; 2. affinity, relationship.
बंधु-दत्त n. property given to a girl by her relatives at the time of marriage, Yaj.ii.144.
बंधु-प्रीति f. 1. affection for a friend; 2. love of a relative.
बंधु-भाव m. friendship.
बंधु-वर्ग m. relations (collectively).
बंधु-हीन a. 1. destitute of relatives; 2. friendless.
बंधुक m. 1. The bandhujīva tree; 2. a bastard.
बंधुका(की) f. An unchaste woman.
बंधूक (I) m. Name of a tree, बंधूकपुष्परजसारुणिता च भूमिः Rt.iii.5.
बंधूक (II) n. A flower of this tree, बंधूककांतिमधुरेषु मनोहरेषु Rt.iii.25.
बंधुका(की) f. An unchaste woman.
बंधुका(की) f. An unchaste woman.
बंधुका(की) f. An unchaste woman.
बंधुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Undulating, fluctuating uneven; 2. inclined, bent, crooked; 3. deaf; 4. handsome, beautiful; 5. mischievous.
बंधुर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Undulating, fluctuating uneven; 2. inclined, bent, crooked; 3. deaf; 4. handsome, beautiful; 5. mischievous.
बंधुर (II) m. 1. A goose; 2. a crane; 3. the vulva; 4. an oil-cake.
बंधुर (III) m. pl. Parched corn.
बंधुर (IV) n. A diadem.
बंधूर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Undulating, uneven; 2. bent, inclined; 3. lovely, beautiful.
बंधूर (II) n. A hole.
बंधूर (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Undulating, uneven; 2. bent, inclined; 3. lovely, beautiful.
बंधुल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Bent, inclined; 2. attractive, beautiful.

बंधुल (II) m. 1. A bastard, परगृहललिताः परान्नपुष्टाः परपुरुषैर्जनिताः परांगनासु । परधननिरता गुणेष्ववाच्या गजकलभा इव बंधुला ललामः Mrich.iv.; 2. an attendant in the chamber of a harlot; 3. the bandhūka tree.
बंधुल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Bent, inclined; 2. attractive, beautiful.
बंधूलि m. the bandhujīva tree.

बंध्य a. (f. ध्या) 1. To be fettered, to be confined, Yaj.ii.243; 2. to be joined together, to be built, to be constructed; 4. barren, fruitless, unproductive (lit. and fig.), अबंध्यकोपस्य विहंतुरापदाम् Kir.i.33; 5. not having the menstmal courses; 6. destitute of.

बंध्य a. (f. ध्या) 1. To be fettered, to be confined, Yaj.ii.243; 2. to be joined together, to be built, to be constructed; 4. barren, fruitless, unproductive (lit. and fig.), अबंध्यकोपस्य विहंतुरापदाम् Kir.i.33; 5. not having the menstmal courses; 6. destitute of.
बंध्या f. 1. A barren woman, e.g. न हि बंध्या विजानाति गुर्वीं प्रसववेदनाम्; 2. a barren cow; 3. a kind of perfume, (बाला).
बंध्य-फल a. useless, idle, vain.
बंध्या-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. the son of a barren woman, i.e. an impossibility, e.g. अयं बंध्यासुतो याति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः.
बंध्या-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. the son of a barren woman, i.e. an impossibility, e.g. अयं बंध्यासुतो याति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः.
बंध्या-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत m. the son of a barren woman, i.e. an impossibility, e.g. अयं बंध्यासुतो याति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः.
बंध्या-दुहितृ f. the daughter of a barren woman, i.e. a thing that does not exist.
बंध्र n. A bond, a tie.
बंब् vt. 1P (pres. बंबति) To go, to move.
बंभर m. A bee.
बंभराली f. A fly.
बांधकिनेय m. A bastard.
बांधव m. 1. A relation, a kinsman, M.v.74, x.55; 2. a maternal relation, M.v.101; 3. a brother; 4. a friend.
बांधव-जन m. kinsmen (collectively), मरणशरणं बांधवजनम् M.M.v.
बांधव्य n. Consanguinity.
